title: INDICVISIONBENCH: BENCHMARKING CULTURAL AND MULTILINGUAL UNDERSTANDING IN VLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a culturally grounded Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset featuring India-specific concepts across 13 topics, including adversarial questions designed to test models' ability to reject false cultural assumptions.

Comparing model performance across English and 10 medium-to-low resource Indic languages using a parallel corpus for Multimodal Machine Translation (MMT), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and Visual Question Answering (VQA) to measure performance disparities.

Analyzing VQA performance disparities across images sourced from different Indian states and union territories, cross-referenced with the query language, to identify region-specific strengths and region-language preferences.
